From Paper Moon King · Price: the target must touch your paper.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: fold paper into a gift.
  • 5: Surge: a creature that touches your paper can't recognize faces for 1 minute (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).
  • 9: It can't tell allies from enemies: it can't Aid, and it can't benefit from its allies' auras or flanking.
  • 13: Area 20 ft.
  • 17: Lasts 1 hour.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
